name: Hawaiian Airlines® World Elite Mastercard®

apr.notes: Variable APR 19.49%–29.49% for purchases (based on creditworthiness); cash advance APR 29.74%. 0% intro APR for 15 months on balance transfers made within 45 days of account opening.

fx_fee.notes: Page states 'No foreign transaction fees means you don't pay additional transaction fees on international purchases.'

categories.label: 3x Points on eligible Hawaiian Airlines and Alaska Airlines purchases
2x Points on gas, dining, and eligible grocery store purchases

rewards.redemption_notes: Atmos Rewards points never expire. Award flights starting at 17,500 Points from West Coast, 25,000 Points from East Coast for Hawaii destinations.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 80,000 Atmos™ Rewards points after spending $2,500 on purchases within the first 90 days

benefits.title: Two Free Checked Bags
benefits.description: Two free checked bags on eligible flights for the primary cardmember when you use your card to purchase eligible tickets directly from Hawaiian Airlines and Alaska Airlines.

benefits.title: 50%-Off Companion Discount
benefits.description: Receive a one-time 50%-off companion discount for roundtrip coach travel between Hawaii and North America destinations on Hawaiian Airlines operated flights or roundtrip North America coach travel on Alaska Airlines operated flights.

benefits.title: $100 Companion Discount
benefits.description: Receive an annual $100 companion discount for roundtrip coach travel between Hawaii and North America destinations on Hawaiian Airlines operated flights or roundtrip North America coach travel on Alaska Airlines operated flights.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.description: No foreign transaction fees means you don't pay additional transaction fees on international purchases.

benefits.title: Points Never Expire
benefits.description: Atmos Rewards points never expire, so you can redeem them anytime.

notes: Standard ongoing annual fee is $99 (first_year $1 reflects a limited-time promo). Variable purchase APR 19.49%–29.49%, cash advance 29.74%, verified from the official Bank of Hawaii/Barclays product page. No foreign transaction fee. Earns 3x on Hawaiian/Alaska Airlines, 2x on gas/dining/grocery, 1x elsewhere. Direct applications on the Barclays site were curtailed around Oct 2025, but the card remains available to new applicants via the Bank of Hawaii/Barclays product page (which carries a current 2026 promotion); status kept 'active'.
